jobs.title: Lead Project Manager - RF
jobs.description:
About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, and software technologies into solutions that help drive advancements in digitized factories, mobility, and digital healthcare, combat climate change, and reliably connect humans and the world. With revenue of more than $9 billion in FY24 and approximately 24,000 people globally, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible™. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and Twitter (X).

Analog Devices Inc. is seeking a motivated and dynamic Project Manager to join our RF Semiconductors (RFS) team. RFS combines ADI’s RF technology groups to create an industry leading team which brings-to-market high performance integrated ASSPs and building block RF ICs, which complete ADI’s signal chains from Antenna to Baseband in ASD, INS and COMs applications. As an engineering project manager within the RFS team you will be responsible for managing the development of new products, advanced core technology and intellectual property (IP) to meet the requirements of our broad customer base. You will work closely with engineers leading various functional aspects of product development projects, planning and coordinating overall development activities. You will be part of a large organization, collaborating with engineers at several locations globally.

Apply now for the opportunity to grow your career and help innovate ahead of what’s possible!

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Planning & Execution
Lead large scale initiatives affecting multiple teams and regions making decisions with long term implications for functions or BU.
Collaborate with Engineering Directors, Product Designers, Engineers, Applications, Marketing, and Manufacturing to define and align project goals with market demands and business objectives.

Project Leadership
Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, and staffing to ensure successful delivery of milestones.
Proactively identify and mitigate obstacles and risks, ensuring project continuity and quality.
Be able to work and lead projects independently.
Design and implement new processes and solutions.

Cross-Functional Coordination
Partner with other Program Managers to prioritize deliverables across concurrent development and sustaining projects.
Facilitate effective communication and alignment across global teams to optimize performance and resolve conflicts.

Stakeholder Engagement
Serve as the primary point of contact for internal communications, providing regular updates, escalating critical issues, and ensuring transparency across all levels.
Ensure compliance with internal standards, customer requirements, and industry regulations throughout the project lifecycle.
Mentor others and actively upskills team members.

Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Project Management, or related field.
5+ years of experience managing complex technical projects in a high-tech or semiconductor environment.
Proven track record of leading cross-functional teams and delivering results in a matrixed organization.
Excellent communication, leadership, and organizational skills.
Us Citizenship or Permanent Resident

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in RF or IC product development cycle from concept to production.
Strong proficiency in project management tools such as MS Project, Confluence, Jira, and Excel (including VBA).
PMP or equivalent certification is a plus.
Demonstrated ability to manage ambiguity, drive strategic initiatives, and influence stakeholders at all levels.
Ability to coach and mentor junior level Project Managers

For positions requiring access to technical data, Analog Devices, Inc. may have to obtain export licensing approval from the U.S. Department of Commerce - Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the U.S. Department of State - Directorate of Defense Trade Controls. As such, applicants for this position – except US Citizens, US Permanent Residents, and protected individuals as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3) – may have to go through an export licensing review process.

Analog Devices is an equal opportunity employer. We foster a culture where everyone has an opportunity to succeed regardless of their race, color, religion, age, ancestry, national origin, social or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, marital status, pregnancy, parental status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, union membership, and political affiliation, or any other legally protected group.

jobs.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Site Reliability Engineering
jobs.description:
As a TPM for SRE, you will partner with SRE leaders and engineers to scale the platform that underpins all of MongoDB’s cloud products. You will drive program execution, strengthen production reliability practices, and coordinate cross-functional efforts across US and EMEA teams. Success in this role means smoother launches, clearer roadmaps, stronger reliability metrics and an SRE organization that's better-equipped to deliver predictability at scale.

This role can be based remotely on the East Coast

What You'll Do

Drive Program Planning & Execution – Define program scope, milestones, and success criteria with SRE engineers and leaders. Manage dependencies across platform teams, keep work clearly tracked in Jira, and deliver on time
Strengthen Production Reliability – Lead change management and launch readiness programs. Partner with SREs and product teams to define and operationalize SLOs/SLIs, and use incident data, metrics, and capacity signals to drive prioritization and continuous improvement
Lead Cross-Functional Coordination – Align SRE with Security, Compliance, Cloud platform, and other engineering teams. Coordinate cross-team incident response, ensure clear follow-through, and build trust as the go-to driver of complex, multi-team efforts
Build Scalable Systems & Processes – Design lightweight frameworks and communication patterns that help SRE deliver reliably at scale. Work yourself out of the "hero" role by leaving teams better-equipped to execute independently

Requirements

8+ years in technical program management, engineering management, or a comparable technical role partnering with software engineering teams
Proven track record leading large-scale, cross-team platform initiatives through ambiguity and change
Strong knowledge of production change management, software development lifecycle, and reliability metrics (SLOs, SLIs)
Skilled at shaping roadmaps and managing dependencies
Able to query and interpret metrics, logs, or other data sources to inform decisions and communicate risk
Excellent communicator—clear, concise, and calm—across engineers, cross-functional partners, and executives
Low-ego, highly collaborative, and motivated by ownership of hard problems end to end

Nice to Have

Hands-on or close-partner experience with Kubernetes, cloud networking, or observability stacks (metrics, logs, tracing, alerting)
Prior experience working with or alongside SRE teams
Background in large-scale cloud infrastructure or platform engineering
Familiarity with MongoDB Atlas or other modern cloud database platforms

Why This Role

This role puts MongoDB's values into practice. You'll own hard, ambiguous problems end to end. You'll build together with SRE, engineering, Security, and Compliance to co-create solutions that work across the organization. And you'll think big—scaling the platform and practices that power MongoDB's next phase of growth. You'll be in the critical path of high-impact projects, working with executive stakeholders, and supported to grow in your career.

About MongoDB

MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.

With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.

To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Wanna join the adventure?

Loft Orbital is making space simple by building and operating the infrastructure that enables our customers’ missions. We’re looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to join our Infrastructure team and help deliver complex work efficiently and predictably.

In this role, you’ll bring structure and clarity to a highly cross-functional environment. You’ll coordinate workloads and programs, support global on-call operations, strengthen the team’s ways of working, and make sure risks, dependencies, and escalations are visible and managed. Your work will directly improve the efficiency of our engineering teams and the reliability and scalability of our satellite operations.

This is a high-autonomy role with broad visibility and significant room to shape how you work. You’ll have the opportunity to make a direct impact on how Loft manages and scales its satellite fleet while partnering with teams across Infrastructure, Operations, Solutions, Product Engineering, and other functions.

About this Role:

Support Cloud, Test and Space Infrastructure teams in workload management, program delivery and cross-functional coordination
Support on-call scheduling across global timezones
Own the ways of working within the Infrastructure team and ensure our processes are followed and aligned to necessary standards
Manage internal Risk register and escalation as appropriate to program and cross-functional deliveries

Must Haves:

8+ years of technical program/project management experience in SW and Service Operations
Proficiency with Jira and Confluence
Demonstrated experience facilitating Agile development teams (Scrum, Kanban, or similar)
Analytical mindset plus the ability to develop processes to address operational challenges, automating whenever possible
Strong interpersonal skills; capable of influencing others without formal authority
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to develop materials for an executive audience
Ability to travel at least once per quarter for cross-office collaboration

Nice to Haves:

Background in space industry, tech startups, organizations building both hardware and software solutions
Previous experience working with an international team across time zones
Experience in product management or working closely with product teams
Experience with Python or automation/scripting in software engineering environments and metric generation

Some of Our Awesome Benefits:

100% company-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance option for employees and dependents
Flexible Spending (FSA) and Health Savings (HSA) Accounts offered with an employer contribution to the HSA
100% employer paid Life, AD&D, Short-Term, and Long-Term Disability insurance
Flexible Time Off policy for vacation and sick leave, and 12 paid holidays
401(k) plan and equity options
Daily catered lunches and snacks in office
International exposure to our team in France
Fully paid parental leave; 14 weeks for birthing parent and 10 weeks for non-birthing parent
Carrot Fertility provides comprehensive, inclusive fertility healthcare and family-forming benefits with financial support
Off-sites and many social events and celebrations
Relocation assistance when applicable
Research shows that while men apply to jobs where they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other underrepresented people tend to only apply when they meet 100% of the qualifications. At Loft, we value respectful debate and people who aren’t afraid to challenge assumptions. We strongly encourage you to apply, even if you don’t check all the boxes

Who We Are

Loft: Space Made Simple.

Founded in 2017, Loft provides governments, companies, and research institutions with a fast, reliable, and simple way to deploy missions in orbit.

We integrate, launch, and operate spacecraft, offering end-to-end missions as a service across Earth observation, IoT connectivity, on-orbit AI, national security missions, and more. Leveraging our existing space infrastructure and an extensive inventory of satellite buses, Loft is reducing years-long integration and launch timelines to months. With more than 30 missions flown, Loft’s flight heritage and proven technologies enable customers to focus on their mission objectives.

With a growing fleet on track to reach 30 satellites by 2027, we are scaling up quickly across our offices in San Francisco, CA | Golden, CO | and Toulouse, France to meet accelerating demand for space infrastructure.

As an international company your resume will be reviewed by people across our offices so please attach a copy in English.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

State law requires us to tell you the base compensation range for this role, which is $150,000- $190,000 per year. This is determined by your education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities. The salary range for this role is intentionally wide as we evaluate individuals based on their unique experience and abilities to fit our needs. Most importantly, we are excited to meet you, and see if you are a great fit for our team. What we can’t quantify for you are the exciting challenges, supportive team, and amazing culture we enjoy.

WSP is currently initiating a search for an experienced Aviation Energy & Utilities Program Manager in Newark, NJ.
This is a full time in-office position in our Newark, NJ office. You will be supporting the delivery of infrastructure projects related to aviation energy, including Central Utility Plants (CUP), Central Heating and Refrigeration Plants (CHRP), and Cogeneration (COGEN) facilities.

The successful candidate will lead multidisciplinary teams through planning, design, procurement, construction, and commissioning of aviation energy & utilities projects. This role will serve as a technical leader and/or owner’s representative and trusted advisor to airport clients, ensuring the successful execution of aviation energy & utilities projects in active airport environments, while maintaining regulatory requirements, safety/security standards, airport design & construction standards and operational constraints.

Lead and manage energy & utility infrastructure projects such as CUP/CHRP/COGEN from concept through commissioning.
Technical expert in the review/development of energy and utility systems, including turbines, electrical, controls
Develop project scopes, schedules, budgets, staffing plans, and technical approaches.

Conduct project meetings and develop progress reports

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, AI, and software technologies into solutions that combat climate change, reliably connect humans and the world, and help drive advancements in automation and robotics, mobility, healthcare, energy and data centers. Project Manager- Energy Team

Location:
Wilmington, MA. USA - Hybrid onsite expectation

The Group

The Data Center and Energy (DCE) Division’s purpose is to engineer a decarbonized, cleaner, and a more sustainable electrified future. Developing solutions for the digitized grid, renewable energy generation, energy storage, EV charging infrastructure, smart meters, and AI/data centers, the group supports customers with break-through technology to convert, manage, and store electrical power as well as meet the exponential needs of the AI/data center markets.

The Position

The Data Center and Energy Division is seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead teams working on the development of new solutions for the Energy Conversion, Energy Management, Energy Storage, and Data Center markets. The successful candidate will lead project development teams taking responsibility for planning, execution, and delivery from project initiation through to release of the final system solution in volume to the customer.

Requirements/Responsibilities

Work closely with functional stakeholders such as Marketing, Engineering, and Manufacturing to develop a clear definition for the project that meets market requirements and internal company goals.
Ensure that the appropriate level of due diligence is applied to the business justification for a project prior to the project entering the development phase.
Develop the execution plan for the project. This includes working with functional leadership to build a schedule, staffing plan, risk analysis and mitigation plan, and budget in support of project goals.
Oversee the successful execution of the plan:
Manage the project bounding box; schedule, scope, budget and staffing, and additionally full factory cost (FFC) to ensure the project stays on track and within budgetary commitments.
Continually evaluate project risks and take appropriate action to mitigate.
Work closely with functional team leads to ensure project deliverables and dependencies are being met.
Coordinate the day-to-day project activities, priorities, meetings and communications ensuring alignment across all cross functional teams while optimizing performance at a project level.

Serve as the focal point for project communications. Compile regular project status for all stakeholders and effectively escalate critical issues and risks as necessary.
Ensure the project is developed in compliance with specified internal, customer or industry standards, processes and procedures.
Drive a culture of continuous improvement by ensuring post-release lessons learned activities for the project are completed
Serve as a champion for advancing Project Management best practices and new methodology.
Ensure that the project schedule is maintained and key project milestones of POC (Proof of Concept), samples and release date are achieved.
Ensure that each development function (Electrical Engineering, Software Development, Mechanical Engineering, Product Evaluation, Test Engineering, Marketing, and others) and project stakeholders/contributors are aware of the key milestone commitments and all critical information and changes relating to the project through team meetings and other communication.
Coordinate the qualification/reliability requirements of the project including overseeing the qualification schedule and handling of the test results in the event of failure. This entails collaborating with various disciplines including qualification, design, test, and packaging engineers.
Manage project change requests which may fundamentally impact the schedule and/or cost of the project.

Bachelor’s degree in a technical discipline

jobs.description:
Job Description:

Building trusted markets — powered by our people

At Cboe Global Markets, we inspire our people to solve complex challenges together because what we do matters. We provide the financial infrastructure that powers the global economy. As a leading provider of market infrastructure and tradable products, Cboe delivers cutting-edge trading, clearing and investment solutions to market participants around the world.

We’re building meaningful ways to support professional and personal development while strengthening the trust we’ve earned as a global market leader. Our teams are empowered to share ideas, actively pursue them and bring on a challenge. As champions of internal mobility and access to opportunity, we encourage our people to “go for it” and equip our managers with the training to coach their teams to the next level. We strive to provide employees a safe space to network, share ideas and create opportunities.

To support strong partnership and team connection, this role follows a four day in office work model.

Location Overview

Cboe HQ is located in the historic Old Post Office district, it’s a landmark that blends classic architecture with modern amenities. The building features expansive spaces with high ceilings and large windows, offering an abundance of natural light and panoramic views of the city skyline and the Chicago River.

With its prime location in the heart of downtown, the OPO Building provides easy access to major transportation hubs, including Union Station and multiple CTA lines, making it convenient for commuters. The building is home to a variety of amenities, including restaurants, a fitness center, and collaborative workspaces, creating a vibrant and dynamic work environment in one of Chicago's most iconic areas.

Role Overview

Infrastructure Project Management is redefining strategic execution at Cboe—transforming how Global Infrastructure delivers innovation through disciplined intake, transparent roadmaps, and relentless accountability.

The Infrastructure Project Manager partners with engineering teams across Global Infrastructure to deliver complex technical initiatives. This is not a generalist PM role—success requires genuine technical fluency across infrastructure domains and the ability to engage credibly with engineers on architecture decisions, deployment strategies, and operational tradeoffs.

Projects span the full infrastructure stack including data center strategy, network architecture, platform modernization, enterprise systems, automation, observability, and security initiatives. The person in this position serves as the central point of coordination for projects spanning multiple infrastructure domains—translating complexity into clear plans, aligning competing priorities, and driving accountability from kickoff through production deployment.

Your responsibilities will be:

Project Execution

Lead engineering teams through the full project lifecycle, from requirements through production deployment and post-implementation review
Build and maintain roadmaps that connect technical execution to business priorities
Coordinate cross-functional activities including migrations, deployments, and production changes

Stakeholder Management

Serve as primary point of coordination across infrastructure engineering teams
Interface with all departments at Cboe Global Markets during enterprise level projects and programs
Communicate project status clearly and accurately to stakeholders at all levels Escalate issues appropriately when project health requires intervention

Risk Management

Identify risks early and develop mitigation strategies before they become blockers
Assess the impact of changes across interconnected systems and environments and generate mitigation plans when necessary
Document lessons learned and apply them to improve project outcomes

The ideal candidate has

The drive to take ownership of outcomes, not just tasks. You communicate honestly—even when the news isn't great—because that's how trust gets built. You're comfortable navigating organizational complexity and know when to escalate. Engineers respect you because you understand their constraints and earn credibility through competence.
Experience: 3–7 years of project management experience in technology or infrastructure environments, with a track record leading engineering teams through complex technical projects
Domain Knowledge: Hands-on experience with infrastructure domains such as network engineering, data center operations, systems administration, or enterprise platforms
Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical status for diverse audiences
Project Management Expertise: Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools – Atlassian and Microsoft Suites, AI Tools, ; experience operating within a structured project management organization with defined processes

Preferred

Project Management Professional certification (PMP)
Experience in financial services or other regulated industries
Experience with data center migration or infrastructure buildout projects

Benefits And Perks

We value the total wellbeing of our people – including health, financial, personal and social wellness. We believe standard benefits like health insurance and fair pay are a given at any organization. Still, you should know we offer:

Fair and competitive salary and incentive compensation packages with an upside for overachievement 
Generous paid time off, including vacation, personal days, sick days and annual community service days 
Health, dental and vision benefits, including access to telemedicine and mental health services 
2:1 401(k) match, up to 8% match immediately upon hire 
Discounted Employee Stock Purchase Plan  
Tax Savings Accounts for health, dependent and transportation 
Employee referral bonus program  
Volunteer opportunities to help you give back to your communities  

Some of our associates’ favorite benefits and perks include: 

Complimentary lunch, snacks and coffee in any Cboe office 
Paid Tuition assistance and education opportunities 
Generous charitable giving company match 
Paid parental leave and fertility benefits  
On-site gyms and discounts to other fitness centers 
Paid Time Off

Our Mission

The OPENSITY Project Manager will play a vital role in ensuring that all client implementations, transitions, and business transformation projects are successfully planned, sourced, and executed to expectations.

As a Project Manager, you will have the goal of ensuring timely, on budget, and high-quality delivery of all milestone deliverables and outcomes through effectively managing scope, risk, and resources using proven and appropriate Project Management Institute methodologies (, Waterfall,, etc.). Successful candidates must have the team leadership and professional background in the legal and/or corporate outsourcing industry to successfully manage multiple projects and client relationships in a fast-paced environment.

The OPENSITY Project Manager will serve as a leader in successfully managing assigned implementations through effective project management coordination and flawless delivery.

Job Responsibilities

Serves as the primary liaison with key client representatives with the goal of owning the service delivery relationship;
Lead the delivery of complex initiatives with multiple workstreams, including creating project plans, identifying, and tracking key milestones, and communicating progress regularly to stakeholders that provides effective coordination and communication of client deliverables.
Effectively executes project forecasts and work schedules implemented by the Sr. Director of Solutions (SDS);
Ensures client and project requirements are being met with the highest quality and accuracy through verification and communicating routinely with both the client and internal partners;
Consistently delivers proactive communication with clients and when client issues arise addresses those issues or expeditiously escalates to the SDS;
Ensures that an up to date record is maintained with regard to the status of all projects being worked on;
Demonstrates leadership to both the client and internal partners, delivering project objectives professionally and with high quality.
Instills confidence with the client and serves as a primary public face of Epiq’s high-quality service delivery offering.
Guide and manage the project in every aspect, including the intersection of technology, processes, and change management
Facilitate the definition of project missions, goals, tasks, dependencies, and resource requirements
Develop comprehensive project management plans that stakeholders, teams, and sponsors can follow throughout each phase of the project.
Negotiate and influence across cross-functional teams to ensure appropriate resourcing levels are engaged and maintained throughout the execution of the plan.
Work with the teams to identify and manage risks with the project and the affectively, performing risk analyses, and preparing and communicating risk mitigation strategies.
Continuously ensure our Customers and Stakeholders are confident about the program delivery via impactful and comprehensive communications
Build credibility, establish rapport, and maintain communications with internal and external stakeholders
Support business development activities such as identification, proposal development, and other pursuit activities at clients

Leadership Competencies

Results Oriented
– Sets stretch goals for personal and team accomplishment and works tenaciously to achieve those goals; acts with a sense of urgency; takes the initiative on actions; establishes metrics to monitor progress and measure success; maintains focus by avoiding or overcoming roadblocks.

Client Focus
– Engages with the clients, both internal and external, and their needs as a primary focus; builds a sustaining collaborative and productive relationship with clients; seeks to understand client situations, issues, expectations, etc.; takes appropriate action to meet client needs and address concerns; implements or utilizes methods to monitor and evaluate client feedback; appropriately meets client needs without jeopardizing business outcomes or results.

Communicating with Impact
– Expresses thoughts, ideas and information in a clear and compelling manner; organizes thoughts logically and highlights the critical points; adjusts messaging appropriately to suit the audience; ensures understanding through active listening and seeking input from the audience; addresses and interprets questions and points from others with appropriate responses.

Planning and Organizing
– Develops plans and goals that align with and support business strategies; translates objectives into action plans; identifies tasks critical to business success and allocates resources accordingly; effectively manages time to achieve success; handles multiple demands and competing priorities successfully; delegates appropriately.

Problem Solving
– Identifies problems by detecting patterns or connections; researches and analyzes problems; determines alternative solutions and creates action steps to solve the problem; thinks and acts quickly and effectively in a variety of situations; solves the problem while maintaining a balance between the time invested, the amount of information needed and the magnitude of the problem; evaluates both the short- and long- term consequences of decisions.

Required Qualifications & Characteristics

Bachelor's degree required. Preferred degree in: Business, Engineering, or Computer Science fields
Solid background in operations and technical staff management.
Minimum of 5 years of experience with large project, program, or portfolio management ideally with outsourced services
Certification in project management disciplines (PMP, Certified BA, , etc) highly desired, or similar level of project management experience
Demonstration of the practical facilitation of, PMI practices, Waterfall methodologies
Possess a combination of business management, leadership, strong strategic and tactical business skills
Expertise in project management of solution delivery through planning, development, and coordination of remote teams.
Well established track record of producing high quality results while establishing/maintaining customer relationships at all levels.
Exceptional computer skills. Preferred experience in: Microsoft Suite (MS Project, PPT)
A good balance of technical knowledge and business acumen with a proven track record of driving innovation and business metrics with a customer-first mindset
Assertive and collaborative approach, with the ability to drive innovation and change management with virtual teams across different time zones.
Excellent organization and communication skills with the ability to engage, influence, and inspire partners and executives to drive collaboration and alignment.
Demonstrated ability to plan and manage projects which span Client business, operations, and IT disciplines

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager, NPI
jobs.description:
About Fluidstack

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

The Enablement Team

Examples of key problems the team is working on

Solve adoption as a human problem, not a tooling problem. The barrier to building with AI is rarely the technology anymore, it's unfamiliar workflows and trust, and the patterns that close that gap are what get people building.
Give non-technical builders the same visibility engineers already have. Building software shouldn't require reading code to know whether it's working or where it's stuck, so the frameworks that lower friction and surface progress are what let anyone build.
Build the harness that lets a fleet of agents be trusted with real work. An agent that writes code only matters if someone can watch it run, check what it did, score it, and send it back to try again, so the systems that make agentic work observable and evaluated are what turn agents into something the org can actually rely on.

Role Scope

Drive adoption of the automation platform across every function: data center delivery, supply chain, manufacturing, finance, and operations all run on the tools this org builds, and adoption is what turns shipped software into automated work.
Run the rollout, onboarding, and training programs that take a team from first demo to living in the tools, one function at a time.
Sit with delivery, procurement, and finance teams to find exactly where adoption sticks, then build the fix yourself, whether that's a frontend surface, a dashboard, or the workflow UI that closes the gap.
Measure adoption surface by surface and feed what's not being used back to the product teams as roadmap signal, so production usage decides what ships next.
Own the enablement program across dozens of teams at once, from the first pilot function to the whole company running on the platform.

What We're Looking For

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly,
tell us where you would
.

You've run adoption, rollout, or change programs where real teams changed how they work, and the new workflow stuck after you moved on.
You build frontend surfaces yourself (React, TypeScript, or similar) instead of filing a ticket and waiting on an engineering queue.
You prototype with AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, LLM APIs, MCP) daily and ship what works.
You've held credibility with non-technical operators and platform engineers in the same hour, distilling each side's problem into a fix the other side accepts.
You sit with the people doing the work, watch where they get stuck, and turn what you see into fixes that ship the same week.
You find the unowned problem, take it, and drive it all the way to adopted without anyone assigning you the work.
You measure success by usage, not launches, and you treat a shipped feature nobody uses as a miss.
Bonus: Internal platform or developer enablement programs. Design systems or UI prototyping. Training or documentation programs at scale. Analytics tooling for adoption measurement.

Salary & Benefits

Competitive total compensation package (salary + equity).
Retirement or pension plan, in line with local norms.

jobs.description:
Brief Description

If you get excited about automation, robotics, and using technology to reimagine how a warehouse runs, this role was built for you. As a Business Systems Analyst on our Supply Chain Operations team, you will sit at the intersection of warehouse operations and technology, embedding with our operations teams to understand how work really gets done, then drawing on your experience to design solutions that automate it. You’ll own initiatives end to end: identifying the opportunity, defining requirements, designing and configuring the solution, and continuously improving what’s been built. A central focus of this role will be understanding our operational needs and pain points deeply enough to help determine the right path, whether that means building a Warehouse Management System / Warehouse Execution System internally or implementing an external solution, and then leading the design and delivery of whichever direction we choose, integrated with NetSuite and our broader PCS partner systems.

Job Responsibilities

Own the delivery of a portfolio of warehouse and supply chain technology solutions, partnering with warehouse operations, supply chain, and PCS business functions to understand process needs and pain points and implement system improvements that support them.
Embed with our warehouse and operations teams, observing workflows on the floor and working alongside operators, to fully understand how the business runs, surface pain points, and identify automation opportunities, then translate them into clear requirements, process maps, and a prioritized backlog.
Help define our warehouse automation strategy and a phased roadmap (WMS / Warehouse Execution System initiatives), aligned to operational goals and business priorities.
Lead solution design and configuration for our operational processes, whether built in-house or implemented from a vendor, including its integration with NetSuite (ERP) through our integration middleware, and with material-handling or robotics technologies (e.g., autonomous mobile robots, automated storage and retrieval systems) as those initiatives mature.
Prototype and configure solutions in test environments, demonstrate functionality to warehouse and business users, support user acceptance testing (UAT), and manage the promotion of approved solutions into production.
Build business cases and value analysis to prioritize and justify automation investments.
Identify opportunities to apply AI-augmented workflows that accelerate requirements gathering, process mapping, and documentation, reduce manual effort, and improve operational efficiency, then drive those ideas to execution.
Partner with internal and offshore development teams and supporting automation, managing delivery cadence
Provide hands-on functional production support (issue triage, root cause analysis, and resolution) and drive continuous improvement based on operational metrics and user feedback.
Identify, communicate, and mitigate risks, assumptions, issues, and decisions throughout the full lifecycle of delivering technology solutions.
Support change management by preparing warehouse teams for new and enhanced capabilities through demos, training, and documentation.

Requirements

Who You Are:

You combine a solid understanding of warehouse operations with the technical skill to turn what you see on the floor into working solutions. You’re comfortable with automation, robotics, and AI, communicate clearly, and work well across both technical and operations teams.

You Also Bring

A Bachelor’s Degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Computer Science, or a related field.
3 to 5 years of experience defining requirements and delivering technology solutions for operational end users, ideally in warehouse, distribution, supply chain, or manufacturing environments.
A proven track record of understanding operational processes deeply and designing automation solutions, with the experience to draw on what has worked before and adapt it to our environment.
Big Four or top-tier consulting experience is a strong plus.
Hands-on familiarity with WMS or Warehouse Execution System platforms and core warehouse processes (inbound, outbound, inventory management, picking, and replenishment); experience building, configuring, or implementing such a system is a strong plus.
Demonstrated experience with warehouse automation and process improvement, with exposure to robotics (autonomous mobile robots, AS/RS, conveyor, sortation, RF/mobile devices) and integrating them with WMS and ERP systems a strong plus.
Hands-on NetSuite experience is required, along with familiarity with integration middleware and enterprise integration platforms for connecting systems.
Working knowledge of EDI, JSON, and XML for data integration and file exchange.
Comfort building business cases and translating operational pain points into practical, well-scoped solutions.
Project management experience delivering programs of varying complexity.
Comfort with, or curiosity about, AI-assisted tools for analytics, automation, and process improvement.
Strong conceptual, analytical, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to express complex technical concepts in business terms.
An open mind, a willingness to examine your strongest convictions with humility, and a genuine desire to embrace differing perspectives to make better decisions.

We Are Seeking People Who

Act like owners.
Are continually raising the bar.
Are sincerely open-minded and willing to examine their strongest convictions with humility.
Nurture and embrace differing perspectives to make better decisions.

What's In It For You

Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
Opportunities for professional growth and development.
A supportive and collaborative work environment.
Comprehensive benefits package.

Founded in 2001, by two visionary traders, PCS Wireless, affectionately known as “PCS”, is not your average mobile distributor. Led by fearless entrepreneurs, PCS has completely transformed the landscape of the device resell market, both from a business and a consumer perspective.

Kharon is seeking a full-time Research Analyst based in NYC or Washington D.C. This role requires frequent in-office attendance.

Driving the curation, publication, maintenance, and quality assurance of datasets.

Conducting research on issues in international affairs that impact business risks and identifying relevant data sources.

About Kharon

Kharon is a highly disruptive and incredibly innovative organization that navigates risk at the intersection of global security threats + international commerce.

What does that mean? Great question.

Operating at the nexus of global security, Kharon is on a mission to revolutionize the current landscape. We take really complex data as it relates to global security and empower our clients to not only understand the risk associated with their potential business relationships but to operationalize that data so that they can make the best and most informed decisions possible. From financial crimes and sanctions to export controls and threat identifications, our tools optimize protection against the types of risks that could otherwise be incredibly dangerous and excessively costly to any business. Serving many of today’s leading global financial and multinational institutions, Kharon products are the most powerful in the space with a precision and depth that is absolutely unparalleled.

When you look at any major global crisis event, we’re providing intelligence that’s at the heart of those circumstances. We connect the dots in a way that’s meaningful. Now, we’re experiencing unprecedented growth. As the world continues to evolve in complexity, so too does the demand for our products. Given the significance of our work and the increasing global reliance on our insights, we are looking for a Research Analyst to join us as we work to shape the way businesses perceive and navigate global risks.

The core of this position is dedicated to conducting open-source research on a variety of foreign affairs and national security issues. More specifically, you will be researching, analyzing, and interpreting data as it relates to sanctions, export controls, and criminal/illicit networks. You will be responsible for the diligent pursuit of data as it relates to ever-evolving market demand and our client inquiries. Working collaboratively with the Kharon Research team, you will contribute to the development of new datasets and update existing ones, identifying and utilizing new sources and developing subject matter expertise on the various strategic topics. This includes monitoring new sanctions, enforcement actions, and policy activity by regulatory agencies, as well as conducting research on international affairs that affect business risks. Leveraging your sound analytical approach and research techniques, you will identify data typologies, perform detailed quality assurance, validate and reconcile data, and support new product and partnership initiatives. You’ll also play a key role in curating, publishing, and maintaining datasets, and may write original code to collect primary data across various languages. Cross-functional collaboration is essential as you help build out new research, surface insights from existing content, and report key project metrics to internal stakeholders.

To the right person, this will be the perfect kind of challenge. Our mission is compelling, our product is powerful, and we’re growing at a rate that makes us unstoppable. If you’re looking to be surrounded by people who will inspire you to think and challenge you to grow then look no further. Our team is made up of some of the most visionary and uncompromising individuals you will ever encounter. We don’t take ourselves seriously but we’re serious about the work we do and there is absolutely no slowing us down.

To Keep That Momentum Going, We Do Our Very Best To Make Sure That Each And Every Team Member Is Completely Taken Care Of. We’re Nothing Without Our People And We Strive To Offer a Package That Reflects That. As a Kharon Team Member, You Can Expect
Fully sponsored medical, dental, and vision insurances

AI Research Analyst

Preferred Locations: US Based - New York, New Jersey, Seattle, Chicago, Dallas, Boston

Cognizant is seeking an exceptional AI Researcher to join our AI Market Unit Strategy team. This role is primarily about producing and publishing original Cognizant research and point of view on enterprise AI-led transformation — the research that defines how Cognizant talks about AI in the market, with clients, and with industry analysts. That same research also informs what solutions and offerings Cognizant chooses to build, but the core of this role is the research and the published word.

This is a research-and-publishing role at heart. You will design studies, synthesize findings, and author the white papers, reports, and executive point-of-view content that establish Cognizant's voice on enterprise AI-led transformation — informed by real rigor, not just opinion.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Cognizant's published point of view on enterprise AI-led transformation starts with you.
Analyst relations leans on your research and point of view to represent Cognizant credibly with Gartner, Forrester, IDC, and peers.
Your research also becomes a foundation other teams draw on when shaping offerings and solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Research & Publication

Design and execute primary research studies on enterprise AI-led transformation, AI adoption, and business impact, using rigorous quantitative and qualitative methods.
Write and publish white papers, industry reports, articles, and executive point-of-view content that define Cognizant's narrative on enterprise AI-led transformation.
Adapt core research across formats — from a full white paper to a short article or executive social post — without losing analytical rigor or brand voice.
Maintain a personal publication record and represent Cognizant's research agenda and point of view at conferences, symposia, and analyst events.
Build and maintain proprietary research assets — benchmarks, maturity models, adoption indices — that give Cognizant's published point of view a distinct, evidence-based edge.

Point of View for Analyst Relations

Develop the research, data, and point of view that Cognizant's analyst relations team uses in briefings and inquiries with Gartner, Forrester, IDC, Everest Group, and peers.
Track and interpret the latest AI trends — model releases, agentic systems, regulatory shifts — and translate them into a clear, current Cognizant point of view.
Partner closely with analyst relations to prepare briefing materials, anticipate analyst questions, and keep Cognizant's positioning ahead of the market.
Be available to join briefings directly when deep research or technical credibility is needed to make the case.

Informing Offerings & Solutions

Share research findings and market trends with offering and solution teams so new offerings are grounded in evidence.
Flag where enterprise AI adoption gaps suggest an opportunity for Cognizant to build or extend an offering.

Data & Analytical Rigor

Apply structured research methodology: hypothesis formation, survey and data design, statistical analysis, source validation, and peer review.
Work hands-on with quantitative data — survey results, model benchmarks, usage telemetry — to produce defensible, evidence-based findings.
Build and maintain proprietary research assets: benchmarks, maturity models, and adoption indices that can be reused and cited across Cognizant's go-to-market content.

Industry & AI Intelligence

Maintain deep, current expertise in AI developments including generative AI, agentic systems, large language models, and applied enterprise AI.
Track how AI is transforming specific industries and quantify business impact through original data rather than secondary sources.
Monitor the competitive AI and analyst landscape to identify research gaps Cognizant is best positioned to fill.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & External Relations

Partner with offering, solution, content strategy, marketing, and business development teams so research consistently feeds both what Cognizant builds and what Cognizant says.
Collaborate with AI engineers, data scientists, and solution architects to ensure technical accuracy of published research and proposed offerings.
Engage with academic institutions, think tanks, and analyst firms to source data, validate findings, and pursue co-authored or co-branded research.
Build and sustain relationships with editors of research and technical publications to place original research and bylines.

Required Qualifications

Experience & Background

8+ years of experience as a researcher or analyst producing published research — prior experience at a research or analyst firm such as Gartner, IDC, Forrester, or a research role at a consultancy such as McKinsey is strongly preferred.
A demonstrable publication record — white papers, industry reports, articles, or research notes — showing the ability to produce original, evidence-based research and write it up for a business audience.
Comfort operating as an individual researcher: owning a research agenda, running studies, and publishing under your own byline or firm's name.
Experience researching across at least two industries (e.g., BFSI, healthcare, manufacturing, retail).
Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, AI/ML, Data Science, Statistics, Business, Journalism, or a related field (or equivalent industry research experience).

Skills & Competencies

Deep fluency in AI/ML concepts, generative AI architectures, and enterprise AI use cases, with the ability to speak to the latest trends confidently and precisely.
Strong quantitative and analytical skills; comfort designing studies, running analyses, and working with benchmark or survey data.
Exceptional writing ability — able to turn research into clear, compelling published content for executive and practitioner audiences.
Confident, articulate communicator who can hold their own in an analyst inquiry call or briefing and represent Cognizant's point of view live.
Ability to independently scope, run, and deliver a research project end-to-end with minimal oversight.

Preferred Qualifications

Prior tenure as an analyst or researcher at a firm such as Gartner, IDC, Forrester, Everest Group, or McKinsey, with named or bylined published research.
Track record of published, citable research and thought leadership (e.g., named reports, bylined articles, or widely referenced industry studies).
Familiarity with Cognizant's AI services portfolio, including the Cognizant Neuro® AI Platform.
Experience researching or writing on responsible AI, AI governance, or AI ROI measurement.
Established relationships with individual analysts, editors, or journalists at major technology and business publications.

What We Offer

A collaborative, high-performance culture where original research and intellectual curiosity are core to the mission.
Access to Cognizant's global AI research agenda, proprietary data, and direct collaboration with AI practice leaders.
Support and sponsorship for publishing, conference participation, and building an external research profile.

Cognizant (Nasdaq: CTSH) is one of the world's leading professional services companies, engineering modern businesses for the digital era. To contribute to the team activities in generating investment ideas, creating and maintaining large and complex databases, help in preparing various reports like strategy note, morning note, weekly market updates. These activities will help in driving sales and information dissemination to investors and sales force.

Job Context & Major Challenges

Aditya Birla Money Ltd. (ABML) is primarily a Broking Company, deals in Equity, Commodity & Currency. Workforce of ~800 spread across ~40 locations with customer base of in excess of 3 lacs. Commodity operations are managed through its 100% subsidiary Aditya Birla Commodities Broking limited. ABML is one of the leading securities trading companies in the country. ABML operates in a fragmented equity broking business and has a daily turnover of close to 3,000 Crores with a market share of 1%. ABM works in a highly regulated environment with a host of regulators like SEBI, RBI, AMFI, FMC, IRDA etc. regulating its day to day operations. In addition to the regulator ABML is also subject to close monitoring and inspection through various agencies like NSE / BSE / NCDX / MCX / NSDL / CDSL etc. ABML also operates in a highly competitive market mainly in fragmented industry with ABML competition from major National Broking houses like ICICI Securities, HDFC Securities, Angel Broking, MOFSL etc. and a range of local Broking outfits.

The Research team at the Fundamental side values the securities based on the growth prospects and attractiveness of the underlying business. It involves analyzing the financials, competitive advantages of the business, quality of management and competitive environment it operates in among other factors. The theory of Research revolves around the fact that the market price of an asset may deviate from its fair value in short term due to extraneous factors such as market trends or investor sentiments, but will tend to move towards its intrinsic value over the long term.

The Key Responsibilities Of Sr. /Research Analyst Are

To build large databases by extracting and collating appropriate datasets from data vendors like Bloomberg, Reuters, Cline, etc.
To analyse large and complex databases of macro and micro information and create well-structured reports.
To disseminate research reports/output to investors/clients helping them take investment decisions.
To provide research support and inputs for consumption by the investment team in building portfolios and prepare reports/advisory for the clients.
To timely work on and generate investment ideas so as to capture maximum gains out of it.

The Primary Challenges Faced Are

To find investible ideas based on rigorous analysis of data/information sourced from quality database available in the market within a sector, given different risk return profiles and competitive advantages of various companies within a sector.
In a an environment, which is constantly moving and changing, the key challenge is to stay abreast with latest updates in a sector and the companies within it, so as to take nimble investment decisions.
The challenge is to clearly communicate the investment thesis for a company/sector in a manner which clearly highlights the investment case and arguments so that the investment team/investors can take an informed investment decision.
Another key challenge of the role is to take relative investment calls when absolute opportunities are more than what can be accommodated in the portfolio

Critical Skillsets are the individual must have a strong knack for financial analysis and equity research. The role involves minor level of client interaction and hence good interpersonal skills are desirable.

Key Result Areas

KRA (Accountabilities) (Max 1325 Characters)
Supporting Actions (Max 1325 Characters)

KRA1 To be able to build, maintain and analyze large and complex databases of macro and micro information

To build large databases by extracting/collating appropriate datasets from data vendors like Bloomberg, Reuters, Cline, etc. and organize the data into sub-heads (viz. macros / micros / sectoral / valuations).
To understand the growth trends of the industry by analysing parameters affecting the dynamics of the industry.
To analyze data using top-down approach (international asset class level, country level and sector level) and also on a bottom up basis on assigned sectors to come up with investment ideas for the investment team and clients.

KRA2 To be able to conduct quantitative and qualitative analysis of the companies of specific sectors and participate in team research activities

To analyze companies/sectors using tools like ratio analysis, time series and cross sectional analysis, so as to make a judgment regarding investment potential of the various sectors and the companies within various sectors.
To read relevant materials from the industry body and participate in industry conferences to maintain the sharpness in investment analysis.
To meet the managements of a company and understand the key trends in the sector, the company and its future plan.
To project the earnings of the company in medium and long term.

KRA3 To be able to disseminate research based output to investors/clients helping them take investment decisions

To prepare an investment argument based on the findings of the analysis and help the investment team build a portfolio as per the risk/return framework of the investor.
To contribute to various products which require team efforts like strategic investment report, morning report, morning sales note, concalls, weekly report.
To increase the visibility of the research team by contributing articles to various media reports.

At Cboe Global Markets, we inspire our people to solve complex challenges together because what we do matters. We provide the financial infrastructure that powers the global economy. As a leading provider of market infrastructure and tradable products, Cboe delivers cutting-edge trading, clearing and investment solutions to market participants around the world.

As champions of internal mobility and access to opportunity, we encourage our people to “go for it” and equip our managers with the training to coach their teams to the next level. We strive to provide employees a safe space to network, share ideas and create opportunities.

To support strong partnership and team connection, this role follows a four day in office work model.

Location Overview

Cboe HQ is located in the historic Old Post Office district, it’s a landmark that blends classic architecture with modern amenities. The building features expansive spaces with high ceilings and large windows, offering an abundance of natural light and panoramic views of the city skyline and the Chicago River.

With its prime location in the heart of downtown, the OPO Building provides easy access to major transportation hubs, including Union Station and multiple CTA lines, making it convenient for commuters. The building is home to a variety of amenities, including restaurants, a fitness center, and collaborative workspaces, creating a vibrant and dynamic work environment in one of Chicago's most iconic areas.

Role Overview

Infrastructure Project Management is redefining strategic execution at Cboe—transforming how Global Infrastructure delivers innovation through disciplined intake, transparent roadmaps, and relentless accountability.

The Infrastructure Project Manager partners with engineering teams across Global Infrastructure to deliver complex technical initiatives. This is not a generalist PM role—success requires genuine technical fluency across infrastructure domains and the ability to engage credibly with engineers on architecture decisions, deployment strategies, and operational tradeoffs.

Projects span the full infrastructure stack including data center strategy, network architecture, platform modernization, enterprise systems, automation, observability, and security initiatives. The person in this position serves as the central point of coordination for projects spanning multiple infrastructure domains—translating complexity into clear plans, aligning competing priorities, and driving accountability from kickoff through production deployment.

Your responsibilities will be:

Project Execution

Lead engineering teams through the full project lifecycle, from requirements through production deployment and post-implementation review
Build and maintain roadmaps that connect technical execution to business priorities
Coordinate cross-functional activities including migrations, deployments, and production changes

Stakeholder Management

Serve as primary point of coordination across infrastructure engineering teams
Interface with all departments at Cboe Global Markets during enterprise level projects and programs
Communicate project status clearly and accurately to stakeholders at all levels Escalate issues appropriately when project health requires intervention

Risk Management

Identify risks early and develop mitigation strategies before they become blockers
Assess the impact of changes across interconnected systems and environments and generate mitigation plans when necessary
Document lessons learned and apply them to improve project outcomes

The ideal candidate has

The drive to take ownership of outcomes, not just tasks. You communicate honestly—even when the news isn't great—because that's how trust gets built. You're comfortable navigating organizational complexity and know when to escalate. Engineers respect you because you understand their constraints and earn credibility through competence.
Experience: 3–7 years of project management experience in technology or infrastructure environments, with a track record leading engineering teams through complex technical projects
Domain Knowledge: Hands-on experience with infrastructure domains such as network engineering, data center operations, systems administration, or enterprise platforms
Communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate technical status for diverse audiences
Project Management Expertise: Proficiency with project management and collaboration tools – Atlassian and Microsoft Suites, AI Tools, ; experience operating within a structured project management organization with defined processes

Preferred

Project Management Professional certification (PMP)
Experience in financial services or other regulated industries
Experience with data center migration or infrastructure buildout projects

Benefits And Perks

We value the total wellbeing of our people – including health, financial, personal and social wellness. We believe standard benefits like health insurance and fair pay are a given at any organization. Still, you should know we offer:

Fair and competitive salary and incentive compensation packages with an upside for overachievement 
Generous paid time off, including vacation, personal days, sick days and annual community service days 
Health, dental and vision benefits, including access to telemedicine and mental health services 
2:1 401(k) match, up to 8% match immediately upon hire 
Discounted Employee Stock Purchase Plan  
Tax Savings Accounts for health, dependent and transportation 
Employee referral bonus program  
Volunteer opportunities to help you give back to your communities  

Some of our associates’ favorite benefits and perks include: 

Complimentary lunch, snacks and coffee in any Cboe office 
Paid Tuition assistance and education opportunities 
Generous charitable giving company match 
Paid parental leave and fertility benefits  
On-site gyms and discounts to other fitness centers 
Paid Time Off

More About Cboe Global Markets

We’re reimagining the future of the workplace by focusing on what matters most, our people. Our journey is an inclusive one. We’re investing deeply in leadership programs and career development initiatives that ensure everyone has an equal chance to succeed.  

We work with purpose, solving problems with ingenuity, collaboration, and a lot of passion. We’re an engaged and excited team connecting markets across borders and embracing growth in all its forms to achieve incredible outcomes. 

Learn more about life at Cboe on our website and LinkedIn.

Please note that this position is based on our campus in Madison, WI, and requires relocation to the area. We recruit nationally and provide financial relocation assistance.

Implementing software that saves lives.

Join our Project Management team and drive impactful projects to improve patient care in healthcare organizations. Travel across the US (and abroad if you’re interested) as part of a team that leads software installations and ensures the success of newcomers to the Epic community. Use your project management skills to present to hospital leadership, coordinate end-user training, and provide comprehensive support as healthcare providers go live with our software. Enjoy autonomy in decision-making with our full support and guidance. No software experience required. Learn more about our team at https://careers.epic.com/jobs/project-manager/.

Manage projects at the most innovative health systems on the planet.

The top-ranked health systems in U.S. News and World Report are Epic customers. Our community includes major systems like the Mayo Clinic, Johns Hopkins, Cleveland Clinic, and Kaiser Permanente, as well as leading academic medical centers at the University of Wisconsin, University of Michigan, University of California, University of Texas, The Ohio State University, and many more.

Live affordably in a city known for its rising tech talent.

Epic is located just outside Madison, Wisconsin, the second fastest growing market for tech talent in the United States and home to the state capital and the University of Wisconsin. Madison, a city surrounded by water, has received accolades for being the greenest city in America (NerdWallet), the best city for renters (SmartAsset), the fittest city in America (Fitbit), and the third best metro in the US for young professionals (Forbes Advisor).

More than just important work
.

Our uniquely themed campus was designed to heighten your ability to get stuff done in your office, a conference room, or by the fireplace in a comfy chair. All meals are restaurant-quality but cost only a few dollars, and they’re prepared by a team comprised of kitchen talent from restaurants around the country. And, after five years here, you’ll earn a four-week sabbatical anywhere in the world. Staff have kayaked in Patagonia, attended a Beyoncé concert in Ireland, built a library in Tanzania, and run a marathon in Antarctica.

We offer comprehensive benefits to keep you healthy and happy as you grow in your life and career, and your merit-based compensation will reflect the impact your work has on the company and our customers. You'll also be eligible for annual raises and bonuses, as well as stock grants, which give you an even greater stake in the success of Epic and our customers. Healthcare is global, and building the best ideas from around the world into Epic software is a point of pride. As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we know that inclusive teams design software that supports the delivery of quality care for all patients, so diversity, equity, and inclusion are written into our principles. Please see our full non-discrimination statement at https://careers.epic.com/EEO.

Willingness to travel 25-60% of working days, with a typical month including 1-2 trips lasting 2-4 days

jobs.description:
Overview

Employment in this role is conditional upon successful execution of the contract by the client.

The Work

The Quality Program Manager to lead and oversee the implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of our Quality Management Program. This role will play a critical part in ensuring compliance with performance standards and contractual requirements, performing exhaustive analyses, and driving initiatives to enhance quality and operational efficiency.

This position aligns with Cayuse’s core values of Innovation, Excellence, Collaboration, Adaptability, and Integrity by fostering technical solutions that meet customer needs, promoting teamwork, and prioritizing quality in deliverables.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Develop and Implement Quality Programs:
Develop, implement, and sustain the Quality Management Program, ensuring alignment with organizational goals, industry standards, and contract requirements.
Create and maintain the Quality Program Plan (QPP) to ensure alignment with the Performance Work Statement (PWS) and related quality standards.

Quality Assessments and Reporting:
Design, maintain, and execute a robust surveillance schedule and lead comprehensive internal audits, ensuring thorough coverage of processes and deliverables.
Prepare and deliver Monthly Quality Status Reports, presenting detailed metrics and analysis for internal and external stakeholders, including Federal or defense contracting entities.

Performance Measurement and Monitoring:
Evaluate compliance with Performance Work Statement (PWS) standards, Acceptable Quality Levels (AQLs), deliverables, staffing commitments, and overall performance objectives.
Monitor and leverage performance data to ensure contractual obligations and operational goals exceed expectations.

Root-Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement:
Oversee and lead root-cause analyses, corrective action plans, preventive action measures, and trend analyses.
Verify closure of identified issues and track measureable progress through structured processes to ensure sustained improvement.

Coordinate closely with site quality focal points to facilitate program consistency and quality execution.
Ensure independent execution of quality functions, maintaining a clear boundary of responsibilities to avoid conflicts of interest when site data support is provided.
Support team cross-training efforts and ensure seamless coverage of critical quality functions.
Other duties as assigned.

Candidates should demonstrate flexibility and a willingness to adapt to evolving responsibilities as outlined by the client.

Exceptional interpersonal skills with the ability to communicate in a clear, professional, and articulate manner.

Must be self-motivated and able to work well independently as well as on a multi-functional team.

Strong analytical capabilities for interpreting data, identifying trends, and developing actionable insights.

Technical Program Manager

Sunnyvale, California USA

Product & Strategy

About Us

Founded in 2017, Wayve is the leading developer of Embodied AI technology. Our advanced AI software and foundation models enable vehicles to perceive, understand, and navigate any complex environment, enhancing the usability and safety of automated driving systems.

Our vision is to create autonomy that propels the world forward. Our intelligent, mapless, and hardware-agnostic AI products are designed for automakers, accelerating the transition from assisted to automated driving.

In our fast-paced environment big problems ignite us—we embrace uncertainty, leaning into complex challenges to unlock groundbreaking solutions. We aim high and stay humble in our pursuit of excellence, constantly learning and evolving as we pave the way for a smarter, safer future.

At Wayve, your contributions matter. We value diversity, embrace new perspectives, and foster an inclusive work environment; we back each other to deliver impact.

Make Wayve the experience that defines your career!

The role

As a Technical Program Manager at Wayve, you'll lead complex, cross-functional programs across our engineering org - spanning AI, software, robotics, infrastructure, evaluation, validation, data, and product. You'll turn ambiguity into clear plans and keep multi-team delivery predictable in a fast-moving environment.

Working closely with engineering and cross-functional partners, your impact will be measured by your ability to deliver programs, drive efficiency, manage risk, and align execution with business goals. A successful TPM is a force multiplier - helping teams move faster, more effectively, and with purpose.

We hire TPMs across several areas - for example robotics, evaluation & validation, AI platform, and data operations - and we'll explore the best fit with you through the process.

Key Responsibilities

Drive project delivery: Own the project lifecycle and improve delivery outcomes through structured execution and coordination.
Boost efficiency: Identify bottlenecks, streamline workflows, and improve tooling and resource allocation to increase throughput.
Enable cross-team collaboration: Improve alignment across teams through effective communication, shared goals, and faster decisions.
Manage risk proactively: Anticipate issues, develop mitigation plans, and minimise impact on timelines and quality.
Keep stakeholders aligned: Engage regularly with internal stakeholders, manage expectations, and deliver on commitments.
Align with business goals: Ensure programs directly support Wayve's strategic priorities by making smart scope and resource decisions.
Champion continuous improvement: Lead retros, encourage feedback, and implement changes to improve processes, team dynamics, and outcomes.

About You

We're looking for the following skills and experience. (The first three are our must-haves.)

Essential

Bias for action / program delivery: 5+ years leading complex, multi-team software or technology programs in fast-paced or early-stage environments. You get things done.
Technically strong: Comfortable working with engineers and reasoning about modern software, ML, and robotics stacks, even if you don't write code.
Systems thinking: You reason about how the parts of a complex system fit together, and how a change in one area ripples into others.
Stays neutral and adapts under pressure: Effective in high-tension, ambiguous situations; you flex your style to keep people aligned and moving.
